title: Perfect way to start your trip to Seville
text: The food tour was excellent, great tapas and lovely selection of wines.  Caterina was very knowledgeable and happy to answer any questions , not only about the food and wine but about the city in general. A really good way to orientate you to the city.

title: Great experience

author: 906sharmilat

title: Fantastic food, wine and an amazing guide!
text:
Such a wonderful experience from beginning to end! The food, the places we visited, and the wine tasting were all excellent. But what really made the evening special was our guide, Remy. His knowledge was incredible, and his enthusiasm, positive energy, and lovely personality were absolutely contagious!

It was such a fun and authentic way to discover Seville, enjoy delicious food, and meet new people. I had an amazing time and would absolutely recommend this experience, especially to anyone exploring the city solo
author: m_t_fic

title: Great fun with Remy
text: A very entertaining evening eating local delicacies and drinking in the city. Remy took us to spots that we would never have found on our own and told us about the history in a very entertaining way. A wonderful way to get to know the city with a local. Gracias, Remy!
author: Sausagekay

title: A Fun Evening
text: Remy was our guide and he was VERY enthusiastic! Lots of information and energy. He did a great job explaining everything. Very much enjoyed the tour.
author: tpugel

title: Great time and wonderful experience!
text: We had an absolutely wonderful experience on our food tour with Carolina! She was fantastic, and the entire tour exceeded our expectations. Every tapas dish was delicious, and the wine was excellent. Carolina made the experience even more enjoyable with her knowledge, enthusiasm, and warm personality. It was a perfect way to experience the local food and wine scene. We thoroughly enjoyed every moment and would highly recommend this tour to anyone looking for a memorable culinary experience!
author: R3900ZRamandas
